title: Acceptance testing and interactive workspace hardening
description: Full acceptance testing of Chatticus workspace on develop and deployed cloud environments, fixing front-end lifecycle and interaction defects.

comments.author: box
comments.text:
Triage rollup 2026-09-14 (Chatticus) for workspace bugs under this parent.

Live on dev.chattic.us/chat (AcceptLoopBot): CONFIRMED Completed header (1e5230), no auto-scroll (cafdb7), create Enter (6a51e1). NOT REPRODUCED concurrent send (235efc), reload→sign-in (5e4c9a). Error banner (38a48c) had no instance to click; code still lacks dismiss.

Code-confirmed: Dynamo list_messages no pagination (267e86), failed turn sticky (a4994a), SSE disconnect→Working (b2ad43), channel-switch stream race (c80b09), loadWorkspace Promise.all (cea55d).

Suggested fix order: (1) 1e5230 clear completed status — small UX win; (2) c80b09 generation guard — prevents cross-talk; (3) b2ad43+a4994a terminal/error turn cleanup together; (4) 267e86 Dynamo pagination — correctness for long threads; (5) cea55d allSettled; (6) cafdb7+6a51e1+38a48c polish; (7) 235efc after slow-bot retest; (8) 5e4c9a narrow or close.
